notes: GR12 (cite.py --check 12.3.6.4 "are effective with the initial state of the runtime modules to which they apply" -> OK §12.3.6.4 12); "in the locale current at the time the collating sequence is used at runtime" -> OK §12.3.6.4 12)). The PCS pair is a per-type static readonly CobolCollation (__COLLATE / __COLLATE_NAT) — established for the module's initial state and never reassigned (no SET format changes the PCS itself; §14.9.39 Format 11 set-locale changes only the current locale). A LOCALE alphabet with a locale-name binds that locale (LocaleCollation(tag)); without one, Resolve() reads RunUnit.Current.Locale LC_COLLATE at EACH use. Probe gr12.cob: PCS IS SVA CUR (SVA = LOCALE sv-SE named; CUR FOR NATIONAL IS LOCALE): alphanumeric "oz" < "öa" (Swedish, ö after z) both before and after SET LOCALE LC_COLLATE TO en-US (named arm fixed); national compare gives root order under en-US and Swedish after SET LOCALE LC_COLLATE TO SV (current-locale arm follows). pb64t1_locale_declare pins the current-locale PCS following SET LOCALE (and the named-locale alphabet via SORT); pb101_alphabet_locale_pcs pins the current-locale PCS in relations/SORT/MAX/ORD/CHAR.
